design.primary_comparison: C versus A within each obligation and model
design.analysis: Report every selected case, including deferred and unknown. One obligation per project makes requirement and project levels coincide in this cohort; do not estimate separate variance components. Repetitions are nested, not independent requirements. Human ordinal labels remain a separate confirmatory gate.

selection_rule: One source-bound, browser-observable obligation from each of six distinct open-source projects already present in the pinned source corpus. TodoMVC Clear completed and RealWorld comment Delete have earlier exploratory generations and are designated explicit replications; the other four have no known generation for these obligations. Preserve all six identities and all admission failures. No replacement after generation begins; any changed target requires a separately versioned selection before its first provider call.
limitations: Purposive, not random: the operator knew earlier project-level outcomes and, before this corrective freeze, discovered case-level TodoMVC and RealWorld outcomes in private custody. Those two cases are outcome-informed replications, not independent discovery samples. Prospective applies only to this cohort's future A/B/C generations. Literature-category and human severity labels are not established by this manifest.

cases.target: After Clear completed removes the last completed todo, the Clear completed button is hidden while an active todo remains visible.
cases.admission_issue: The later v5 instrument qualified 9/9 controls and its pre-generation LLM panel returned 3/3 ACCEPT for the earlier pilot. Before any new replication, audit the exact frozen v5c prompt, browser runtime and outcome custody; do not substitute the older 7/7 deferred instrument.

cases.target: Only the comment author sees the Delete comment action on an article, while another authenticated viewer still sees the comment.
cases.admission_issue: The v4 instrument qualified 11/11 controls; prompt review gave 2 ACCEPT and 1 DEFER, followed by a separate 3/3 no-material-blocker adjudication before its earlier generation. Audit the type-clarification change from v3 to v4 and context cues before repeating; visible action is the endpoint, not button enablement.

cases.target: Delete permanently removes one selected item from Deleted files after a fresh read while an unrelated trashed item remains.
cases.admission_issue: Show that the post-refresh state is authoritative, not only a client-side list illusion; prior reviewers did not accept the endpoint.

cases.target: The Project Statistics screen visibly displays the generation date matching a frozen generation clock, alongside unchanged title, revision and counts.
cases.admission_issue: Declare a neutral data interface and hidden browser clock without a date field; accept equivalent date formats and define the generation event.

cases.target: On the task board, an overdue due date is visibly red and an upcoming due date is visibly black under a frozen date/time and two task fixtures.
cases.prior_status: new candidate; no known E2E generation for this obligation
cases.admission_issue: Frozen timezone and computed-color semantics must distinguish the due-date rule from unrelated card styling and inaccessible color-only cues.

cases.target: Opening the detail page of a document with an inbox tag automatically requests and shows available suggestions, without clicking Suggest.
cases.prior_status: new source-grounded candidate; no known E2E generation for this obligation
cases.admission_issue: The source says suggestions are requested automatically, not that the model always returns one. Freeze available suggestion data and distinguish a missing request from an empty model response; manual Suggest and a non-inbox document are controls.
